nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p3/2 spectrum shows two Ni²⁺ peaks of equal area assigned to NiO/Ni₃S₂ and Ni(OH)₂, indicating half surface Ni in Ni₃S₂ and half in Ni(OH)₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the Ni 2p3/2 XPS spectrum (Figure 3a), we could see that the two deconvoluted Ni²⁺ peaks (assigned to NiO and Ni(OH)₂) are having almost the same area under the peak and Ni²⁺ assigned to NiO could also be assigned to Ni²⁺ in Ni₃S₂.
